Subject:          Correspondence in support of the Christopher M. Crane Clean Energy Center
                  (CCEC) License Amendment Request for Proposed Changes to CCEC Security
                  Plan

References:       1. "License Amendment Request - Proposed Changes to Christopher M.
                     Crane Clean Energy Center (CCEC) Security Plan, Training and
                     Qualification Plan, and Safeguards Contingency Plan, Revision O" dated
                     October 24, 2025 (ML25300A118)

In Reference 1, Constellation Energy Generation, LLC (CEG) requested an amendment to
Renewed Facility License (RFL) Number DPR-50 for the Christopher M. Crane Clean Energy
Center (CCEC) and approval of the proposed Christopher M. Crane Clean Energy Center
Security Plan, Training and Qualification Plan and Safeguards Contingency Plan. The proposed
amendment would revise the CCEC RFL to reflect the requirements associated with the security
changes for the operating facility.

Enclosure 1 to this letter is being provided to aid the NRC staff in the review and approval of the
requested action.

There are no regulatory commitments contained in this letter.
